correctness.rationale: The original icosahedron has 12 vertices, 30 edges, 20 triangles; its regular one-third truncation has 60 vertices and 90 facet-adjacency edges. On a generic direction an edge is on the projection silhouette exactly if incident outward facet normals have opposite signs; central I section vertices count old edges with opposite endpoint signs. Each regular hexagonal facet has three opposite pairs of edges; on its facet-normal wall exactly three adjacent facet signs face each way, so crossing those additional walls leaves N_T unchanged. Original opposite vertex normals induce six great circles with no triple crossings: 32 regions. Inspected exact Z[sqrt5] program establishes one representative of each 32 sign masks: 12 give shadow/section (20,10), 20 give (18,12). Thus N_T+S_I=30 throughout all generic chambers, beyond random samples. Independently rebuilt actual 60 coordinates, projected in 600 pseudorandom directions and computed convex hulls and central edge crossings: all complementary; this is corroboration only. Previously known spherical chamber area 20(3θ−π) yields exact probabilities and mean.
